$comment: SoFurry's per-submission choices. Type ids are the API's own (developer.sofurry.com/dev-docs, Get Uploader Settings): the category is the type id rounded down to the nearest ten. Only image categories are listed because the connector posts images. Values are strings, as for every post option.

FolderIds.label: Folder IDs
FolderIds.help: Optional. Folders to add the submission to: open a folder on SoFurry and copy its ID from the URL. Separate several with commas.
FolderIds.message: Folder IDs must be comma-separated IDs.

PixelPerfect.label: Pixel-perfect display
PixelPerfect.help: Turns off lossy compression, for pixel art.
